verses.13: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
verses.14: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
verses.15: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,
verses.16: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.17: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
verses.18: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
verses.19: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
verses.20: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
verses.21: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
verses.22: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.
verses.23: He laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

verses.1: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.2: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
verses.3: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.4: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;
verses.5: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.6: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.7: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
verses.8: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.9: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
verses.10: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.11: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.12: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.13: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.14: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.15: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.16: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
verses.17: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.18: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
verses.19: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without defect;
verses.20: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
verses.21: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.22: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.23: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.24: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.25: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
verses.26: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
verses.27: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
verses.28: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
verses.29: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.30: one male goat, to make atonement for you.
verses.31: Besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

verses.1: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
verses.2: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.3: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
verses.4: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.5: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.6: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.7: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
verses.8: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; all without defect;
verses.9: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
verses.10: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs:
verses.11: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.12: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
verses.13: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; all without defect;
verses.14: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
verses.15: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.16: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.17: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.18: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.19: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
verses.20: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.21: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.22: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.23: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.24: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.25: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.26: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.27: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.28: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.30: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.31: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
verses.32: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.33: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.34: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.35: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no regular work;
verses.36: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.37: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.38: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.39: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
verses.40: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.1: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.
verses.2: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.3: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
verses.4: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
verses.5: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
verses.6: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,
verses.7: and her husband hears it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
verses.8: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.
verses.9: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul, shall stand against her.
verses.10: “If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
verses.11: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn’t disallow her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.12: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
verses.13: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.14: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her. He has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.15: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
verses.16: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

verses.1: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.2: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
verses.3: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.4: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”
verses.5: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.6: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.7: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
verses.8: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
verses.9: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
verses.10: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
verses.11: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
verses.12: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.13: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
verses.14: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
verses.15: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
verses.16: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
verses.17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
verses.18: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.19: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
verses.20: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”
verses.21: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:
verses.22: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.23: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
verses.24: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
verses.25: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.26: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
verses.27: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.28: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
verses.29: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
verses.30: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
verses.31: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.32: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.33: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
verses.34: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.35: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
verses.36: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
verses.37: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.38: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
verses.39: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
verses.40: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
verses.41: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.42: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
verses.43: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
verses.44: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
verses.45: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
verses.46: and sixteen thousand persons),
verses.47: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.48: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
verses.49: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
verses.50: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
verses.51: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
verses.52: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
verses.53: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
verses.54: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

verses.1: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;
verses.2: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.3: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.4: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
verses.5: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
verses.6: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?
verses.7: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
verses.8: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
verses.9: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
verses.10: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
verses.11: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
verses.12: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
verses.13: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight, was consumed.
verses.14: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
verses.15: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
verses.16: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
verses.17: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.18: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have each inherited their inheritance.
verses.19: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
verses.20: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
verses.21: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.22: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.
verses.23: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.24: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
verses.25: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.26: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.27: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
verses.28: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.29: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
verses.30: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
verses.31: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
verses.32: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
verses.33: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
verses.34: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.35: Atrothshophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
verses.36: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.37: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.38: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.39: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
verses.40: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
verses.41: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
verses.42: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

verses.1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.2: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.3: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.4: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.
verses.5: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
verses.6: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.7: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
verses.8: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
verses.9: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.
verses.10: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
verses.11: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.12: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.13: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.14: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.15: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.16: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
verses.17: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
verses.18: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
verses.19: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
verses.20: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
verses.21: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
verses.22: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
verses.23: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
verses.24: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.25: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
verses.26: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
verses.27: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
verses.28: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
verses.29: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
verses.30: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
verses.31: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
verses.32: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
verses.33: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
verses.34: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
verses.35: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
verses.36: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.37: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.38: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.39: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
verses.40: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.41: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
verses.42: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
verses.43: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.44: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.45: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
verses.46: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
verses.47: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.48: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.49: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.50: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.51: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.52: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
verses.53: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
verses.54: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.55: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
verses.56: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”

verses.1: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.2: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
verses.3: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
verses.4: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
verses.5: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
verses.6: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
verses.7: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
verses.8: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
verses.9: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
verses.10: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
verses.11: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
verses.12: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
verses.13: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
verses.14: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance.
verses.15: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
verses.16: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.18: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
verses.19: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.20: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.22: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.23: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.24: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.25: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.26: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.27: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.28: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
verses.29: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

verses.1: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.2: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in. You shall give suburbs for the cities around them to the Levites.
verses.3: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
verses.4: “The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
verses.5: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the suburbs of their cities.
verses.6: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
verses.7: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their suburbs.
verses.8: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many; and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
verses.9: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.10: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.11: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
verses.12: The cities shall be to you for refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
verses.13: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
verses.14: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
verses.15: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
verses.16: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.17: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.18: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.19: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
verses.20: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,
verses.21: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meets him.
verses.22: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
verses.23: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
verses.24: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
verses.25: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.26: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, where he flees,
verses.27: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,
verses.28: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.29: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.30: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.
verses.31: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
verses.32: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.33: “‘So you shall not pollute the land in which you are; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
verses.34: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in the middle of which I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell in the middle of the children of Israel.’”

verses.1: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
verses.2: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
verses.3: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.4: When the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
verses.5: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks right.
verses.6: This is the thing which Yahweh does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best; only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
verses.7: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.8: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.9: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
verses.10: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:
verses.11: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
verses.12: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.13: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.1: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.2: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.3: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them;
verses.4: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
verses.5: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
verses.6: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
verses.7: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites, and to all the places near there, in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.8: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
verses.9: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
verses.10: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
verses.11: Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!
verses.12: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
verses.13: Take wise men of understanding and well known according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
verses.14: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
verses.15: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
verses.16: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
verses.17: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
verses.18: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.19: We traveled from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.20: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.
verses.21: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
verses.22: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
verses.23: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe.
verses.24: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.25: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”
verses.26: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.
verses.27: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.28: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
verses.29: Then I said to you, “Don’t dread, neither be afraid of them.
verses.30: Yahweh your God who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.31: and in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahweh your God bore you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
verses.32: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,
verses.33: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.34: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, and was angry, and swore, saying,
verses.35: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.36: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
verses.37: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
verses.38: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.39: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, and your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
verses.40: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
verses.41: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh, we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
verses.42: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you; lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
verses.43: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
verses.44: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
verses.45: You returned and wept before Yahweh; but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
verses.46: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

verses.1: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
verses.2: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
verses.3: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
verses.4: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
verses.5: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
verses.6: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
verses.7: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
verses.8: So we passed by from our brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.9: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.10: (The Emim lived therein before, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim.
verses.11: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.12: The Horites also lived in Seir before, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)
verses.13: “Now rise up, and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
verses.14: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea, until we had come over the brook Zered, were thirty-eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
verses.15: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
verses.16: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.17: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
verses.18: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
verses.19: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.20: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim: Rephaim lived there before; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.21: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place;
verses.22: as he did for the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day:
verses.23: and the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and lived in their place.)
verses.24: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.25: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.”
verses.26: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.27: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
verses.28: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
verses.29: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me; until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”
verses.30: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
verses.31: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
verses.32: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
verses.33: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
verses.34: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
verses.35: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
verses.36: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
verses.37: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near; all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.

verses.1: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.2: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people, and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
verses.3: So Yahweh our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
verses.4: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them; sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.5: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides a great many villages without walls.
verses.6: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
verses.7: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
verses.8: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
verses.9: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
verses.10: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.11: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
verses.12: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites:
verses.13: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.14: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
verses.15: I gave Gilead to Machir.
verses.16: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.17: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.18: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. You shall pass over armed before your brothers the children of Israel, all the men of valor.
verses.19: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
verses.20: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
verses.21: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
verses.22: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”
verses.23: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,
verses.24: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
verses.25: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
verses.26: But Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “Let this satisfy you. Speak no more to me of this matter.
verses.27: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
verses.28: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
verses.29: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

verses.1: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.
verses.2: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.
verses.3: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for all the men who followed Baal Peor, Yahweh your God has destroyed them from among you.
verses.4: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
verses.5: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.6: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
verses.7: For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to them, as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
verses.8: What great nation is there, that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you today?
verses.9: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children;
verses.10: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
verses.11: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.12: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
verses.13: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
verses.14: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
verses.15: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
verses.16: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.17: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
verses.18: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
verses.19: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
verses.20: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
verses.21: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;
verses.22: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan; but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.23: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.
verses.24: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.25: When you shall father children, and children’s children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight, to provoke him to anger;
verses.26: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
verses.27: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations, where Yahweh will lead you away.
verses.28: There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.29: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him, when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.30: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God, and listen to his voice.
verses.31: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
verses.32: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
verses.33: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
verses.34: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.35: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
verses.36: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
verses.37: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
verses.38: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
verses.39: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
verses.40: You shall keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you today, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land, which Yahweh your God gives you, forever.
verses.41: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
verses.42: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.43: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.44: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
verses.45: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,
verses.46: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.47: They took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
verses.48: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion (also called Hermon),
verses.49: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.1: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
verses.2: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.3: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
verses.4: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
verses.5: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word: for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain;) saying,
verses.6: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.7: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.8: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself, any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.9: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them; for I, Yahweh, your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me;
verses.10: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.11: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain: for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.12: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.
verses.13: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
verses.14: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
verses.15: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
verses.16: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you; that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.17: “You shall not murder.
verses.18: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.19: “You shall not steal.
verses.20: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.21: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.22: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
verses.23: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.24: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
verses.25: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
verses.26: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.27: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
verses.28: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.29: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children forever!
verses.30: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
verses.31: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.”
verses.32: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
verses.33: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

verses.1: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it;
verses.2: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you; you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.3: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.4: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
verses.5: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.6: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
verses.7: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.8: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
verses.9: You shall write them on the door posts of your house, and on your gates.
verses.10: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities, which you didn’t build,
verses.11: and houses full of all good things, which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out, which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees, which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
verses.12: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.13: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
verses.14: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you;
verses.15: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God; lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
verses.16: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
verses.17: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
verses.18: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight; that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,
verses.19: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
verses.20: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”
verses.21: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
verses.22: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
verses.23: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
verses.24: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
verses.25: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

verses.1: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than you;
verses.2: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them; then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
verses.3: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
verses.4: For he will turn away your son from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
verses.5: But you shall deal with them like this. You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
verses.6: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
verses.7: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples:
verses.8: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.9: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
verses.10: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
verses.11: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command you today, to do them.
verses.12: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
verses.13: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.14: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
verses.15: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
verses.16: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
verses.17: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
verses.18: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt:
verses.19: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.20: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
verses.21: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
