verses.3: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.4: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.5: Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.
verses.6: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
verses.7: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
verses.8: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.
verses.9: But a prophet of Yahweh was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because Yahweh, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.
verses.10: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahweh your God?
verses.11: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of Yahweh is on you.”
verses.12: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
verses.13: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against Yahweh, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”
verses.14: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.
verses.15: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, and gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.
verses.16: At that time king Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.17: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.
verses.18: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.
verses.19: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.
verses.20: Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.
verses.21: For Ahaz took away a portion out of Yahweh’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.
verses.22: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
verses.23: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, which struck him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, so I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
verses.24: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, and cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.25: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.
verses.26: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.27: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

verses.1: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.2: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
verses.3: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of Yahweh’s house, and repaired them.
verses.4: He brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,
verses.5: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify Yahweh, the God of your fathers’ house, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.
verses.6: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in Yahweh our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahweh, and turned their backs.
verses.7: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
verses.8: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment, and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.
verses.9: For, behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.10: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
verses.11: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers, and burn incense.”
verses.12: Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;
verses.13: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
verses.14: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.15: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house.
verses.16: The priests went into the inner part of Yahweh’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in Yahweh’s temple into the court of Yahweh’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.
verses.17: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
verses.18: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace, and said, “We have cleansed all Yahweh’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.
verses.19: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign threw away when he was unfaithful, have we prepared and sanctified. Behold, they are before Yahweh’s altar.”
verses.20: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh’s house.
verses.21: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on Yahweh’s altar.
verses.22: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs, and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
verses.23: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.
verses.24: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
verses.25: He set the Levites in Yahweh’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from Yahweh by his prophets.
verses.26: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.27: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and David king of Israel’s instruments.
verses.28: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.29: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.
verses.30: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.31: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.
verses.32: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
verses.33: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.
verses.34: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them, until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves; for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
verses.35: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of Yahweh’s house was set in order.
verses.36: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced, because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

verses.1: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verses.2: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.
verses.3: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
verses.4: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.
verses.5: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.
verses.6: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.7: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against Yahweh, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.
verses.8: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve Yahweh your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.
verses.9: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion before those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if you return to him.”
verses.10: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.
verses.11: Nevertheless some men of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.12: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by Yahweh’s word.
verses.13: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
verses.14: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.
verses.15: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into Yahweh’s house.
verses.16: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.
verses.17: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves: therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to Yahweh.
verses.18: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good Yahweh pardon everyone
verses.19: who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”
verses.20: Yahweh listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.21: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised Yahweh day by day, singing with loud instruments to Yahweh.
verses.22: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of Yahweh. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings, and making confession to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
verses.23: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.
verses.24: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.25: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel, and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.
verses.26: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.
verses.27: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

verses.1:
Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary?
Who shall live on your holy hill?
verses.2:
He who walks blamelessly does what is right,
and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.5:
he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury,
nor take a bribe against the innocent.
He who does these things shall never be shaken.

verses.1: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.
verses.2:
My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord.
Apart from you I have no good thing.”
verses.3:
As for the saints who are in the earth,
they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
verses.4:
Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god.
Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer,
nor take their names on my lips.
verses.5:
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup.
You made my lot secure.
verses.6:
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places.
Yes, I have a good inheritance.
verses.7:
I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel.
Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.8:
I have set Yahweh always before me.
Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.9:
Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices.
My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.10:
For you will not leave my soul in Sheol,
neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verses.11:
You will show me the path of life.
In your presence is fullness of joy.
In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

verses.1:
Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea;
Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
verses.2:
Let my sentence come out of your presence.
Let your eyes look on equity.
verses.3:
You have proved my heart.
You have visited me in the night.
You have tried me, and found nothing.
I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
verses.4:
As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips,
I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
verses.5:
My steps have held fast to your paths.
My feet have not slipped.
verses.6:
I have called on you, for you will answer me, God.
Turn your ear to me.
Hear my speech.
verses.7:
Show your marvelous loving kindness,
you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
verses.8:
Keep me as the apple of your eye.
Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.9:
from the wicked who oppress me,
my deadly enemies, who surround me.
verses.10:
They close up their callous hearts.
With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.11:
They have now surrounded us in our steps.
They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
verses.12:
He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey,
as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.14:
from men by your hand, Yahweh,
from men of the world, whose portion is in this life.
You fill the belly of your cherished ones.
Your sons have plenty,
and they store up wealth for their children.
verses.15:
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness.
I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

verses.1: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
verses.3:
I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised;
and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.4:
The cords of death surrounded me.
The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.5:
The cords of Sheol were around me.
The snares of death came on me.
verses.6:
In my distress I called on Yahweh,
and cried to my God.
He heard my voice out of his temple.
My cry before him came into his ears.
verses.7:
Then the earth shook and trembled.
The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken,
because he was angry.
verses.8:
Smoke went out of his nostrils.
Consuming fire came out of his mouth.
Coals were kindled by it.
verses.9:
He bowed the heavens also, and came down.
Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.10:
He rode on a cherub, and flew.
Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.11:
He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him,
darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.12:
At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed,
hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.13:
Yahweh also thundered in the sky.
The Most High uttered his voice:
hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.14:
He sent out his arrows, and scattered them;
Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
verses.15:
Then the channels of waters appeared.
The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh,
at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.16:
He sent from on high.
He took me.
He drew me out of many waters.
verses.17:
He delivered me from my strong enemy,
from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
verses.18:
They came on me in the day of my calamity,
but Yahweh was my support.
verses.19:
He brought me out also into a large place.
He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.20:
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness.
According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
verses.21:
For I have kept the ways of Yahweh,
and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.22:
For all his ordinances were before me.
I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
verses.23:
I was also blameless with him.
I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.24:
Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.25:
With the merciful you will show yourself merciful.
With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
verses.26:
With the pure, you will show yourself pure.
With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.27:
For you will save the afflicted people,
but the haughty eyes you will bring down.
verses.28:
For you will light my lamp, Yahweh.
My God will light up my darkness.
verses.29:
For by you, I advance through a troop.
By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.30:
As for God, his way is perfect.
Yahweh’s word is tried.
He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.31:
For who is God, except Yahweh?
Who is a rock, besides our God,
verses.32: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
verses.33:
He makes my feet like deer’s feet,
and sets me on my high places.
verses.34:
He teaches my hands to war,
so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.35:
You have also given me the shield of your salvation.
Your right hand sustains me.
Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.36:
You have enlarged my steps under me,
My feet have not slipped.
verses.37:
I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them.
Neither will I turn again until they are consumed.
verses.38:
I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise.
They shall fall under my feet.
verses.39:
For you have armed me with strength to the battle.
You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.40:
You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me,
that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.41:
They cried, but there was no one to save;
even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.42:
Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind.
I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
verses.43:
You have delivered me from the strivings of the people.
You have made me the head of the nations.
A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.44:
As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me.
The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
verses.45:
The foreigners shall fade away,
and shall come trembling out of their close places.
verses.46:
Yahweh lives; and blessed be my rock.
Exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.47:
even the God who executes vengeance for me,
and subdues peoples under me.
verses.48:
He rescues me from my enemies.
Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me.
You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.49:
Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations,
and will sing praises to your name.
verses.50:
He gives great deliverance to his king,
and shows loving kindness to his anointed,
to David and to his offspring, forever more.

verses.1:
The heavens declare the glory of God.
The expanse shows his handiwork.
verses.2:
Day after day they pour out speech,
and night after night they display knowledge.
verses.3:
There is no speech nor language,
where their voice is not heard.
verses.4:
Their voice has gone out through all the earth,
their words to the end of the world.
In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.5:
which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room,
like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
verses.7:
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul.
Yahweh’s testimony is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.8:
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart.
Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.9:
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever.
Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.10:
More to be desired are they than gold, yes, than much fine gold;
sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
verses.11:
Moreover by them is your servant warned.
In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.12:
Who can discern his errors?
Forgive me from hidden errors.
verses.13:
Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins.
Let them not have dominion over me.
Then I will be upright.
I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
verses.14:
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
be acceptable in your sight,
Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

verses.1:
May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble.
May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
verses.2:
send you help from the sanctuary,
grant you support from Zion,
verses.3:
remember all your offerings,
and accept your burned sacrifice.
Selah.
verses.4:
May He grant you your heart’s desire,
and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.5:
We will triumph in your salvation.
In the name of our God, we will set up our banners.
May Yahweh grant all your requests.
verses.6:
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed.
He will answer him from his holy heaven,
with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.7:
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses,
but we trust the name of Yahweh our God.
verses.8:
They are bowed down and fallen,
but we rise up, and stand upright.
verses.9:
Save, Yahweh!
Let the King answer us when we call!

verses.1:
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh!
How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
verses.2:
You have given him his heart’s desire,
and have not withheld the request of his lips.
Selah.
verses.3:
For you meet him with the blessings of goodness.
You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.4:
He asked life of you, you gave it to him,
even length of days forever and ever.
verses.5:
His glory is great in your salvation.
You lay honor and majesty on him.
verses.6:
For you make him most blessed forever.
You make him glad with joy in your presence.
verses.7:
For the king trusts in Yahweh.
Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
verses.8:
Your hand will find out all of your enemies.
Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verses.9:
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger.
Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath.
The fire shall devour them.
verses.10:
You will destroy their descendants from the earth,
their posterity from among the children of men.
verses.11:
For they intended evil against you.
They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
verses.12:
For you will make them turn their back,
when you aim drawn bows at their face.
verses.13:
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength,
so we will sing and praise your power.

verses.1:
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
verses.2:
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer;
in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.3:
But you are holy,
you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
verses.4:
Our fathers trusted in you.
They trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.5:
They cried to you, and were delivered.
They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
verses.6:
But I am a worm, and no man;
a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.7:
All those who see me mock me.
They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
verses.8:
“He trusts in Yahweh.
Let him deliver him.
Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
verses.9:
But you brought me out of the womb.
You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
verses.10:
I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb.
You are my God since my mother bore me.
verses.11:
Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near.
For there is no one to help.
verses.12:
Many bulls have surrounded me.
Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.13:
They open their mouths wide against me,
lions tearing prey and roaring.
verses.14:
I am poured out like water.
All my bones are out of joint.
My heart is like wax;
it is melted within me.
verses.15:
My strength is dried up like a potsherd.
My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth.
You have brought me into the dust of death.
verses.16:
For dogs have surrounded me.
A company of evildoers have enclosed me.
They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.17:
I can count all of my bones.
They look and stare at me.
verses.18:
They divide my garments among them.
They cast lots for my clothing.
verses.19:
But don’t be far off, Yahweh.
You are my help: hurry to help me.
verses.20:
Deliver my soul from the sword,
my precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.21:
Save me from the lion’s mouth!
Yes, from the horns of the wild oxen, you have answered me.
verses.22:
I will declare your name to my brothers.
Among the assembly, I will praise you.
verses.23:
You who fear Yahweh, praise him!
All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him!
Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.25:
Of you comes my praise in the great assembly.
I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.26:
The humble shall eat and be satisfied.
They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him.
Let your hearts live forever.
verses.27:
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh.
All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.28:
For the kingdom is Yahweh’s.
He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.29:
All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship.
All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him,
even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
verses.30:
Posterity shall serve him.
Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verses.31:
They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born,
for he has done it.

verses.1:
Yahweh is my shepherd:
I shall lack nothing.
verses.2:
He makes me lie down in green pastures.
He leads me beside still waters.
verses.3:
He restores my soul.
He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.4:
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Your rod and your staff,
they comfort me.
verses.5:
You prepare a table before me
in the presence of my enemies.
You anoint my head with oil.
My cup runs over.
verses.6:
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

verses.1:
The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness;
the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.2:
For he has founded it on the seas,
and established it on the floods.
verses.3:
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill?
Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.5:
He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh,
righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.6:
This is the generation of those who seek Him,
who seek your face—even Jacob.
Selah.
verses.7:
Lift up your heads, you gates!
Be lifted up, you everlasting doors,
and the King of glory will come in.
verses.8:
Who is the King of glory?
Yahweh strong and mighty,
Yahweh mighty in battle.
verses.10:
Who is this King of glory?
Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!
Selah.

verses.1: To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.
verses.2:
My God, I have trusted in you.
Don’t let me be shamed.
Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.3:
Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed.
They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.4:
Show me your ways, Yahweh.
Teach me your paths.
verses.5:
Guide me in your truth, and teach me,
For you are the God of my salvation,
I wait for you all day long.
verses.6:
Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness,
for they are from old times.
verses.7:
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions.
Remember me according to your loving kindness,
for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
verses.8:
Good and upright is Yahweh,
therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.9:
He will guide the humble in justice.
He will teach the humble his way.
verses.10:
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth
to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.11:
For your name’s sake, Yahweh,
pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.12:
What man is he who fears Yahweh?
He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verses.13:
His soul shall dwell at ease.
His offspring shall inherit the land.
verses.14:
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him.
He will show them his covenant.
verses.15:
My eyes are ever on Yahweh,
for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.16:
Turn to me, and have mercy on me,
for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.17:
The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verses.18:
Consider my affliction and my travail.
Forgive all my sins.
verses.19:
Consider my enemies, for they are many.
They hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.20:
Oh keep my soul, and deliver me.
Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
verses.21:
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
for I wait for you.
verses.22:
Redeem Israel, God,
out of all his troubles.

verses.1:
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity.
I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
verses.2:
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me.
Try my heart and my mind.
verses.3:
For your loving kindness is before my eyes.
I have walked in your truth.
verses.4:
I have not sat with deceitful men,
neither will I go in with hypocrites.
verses.5:
I hate the assembly of evildoers,
and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.6:
I will wash my hands in innocence,
so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;
verses.7:
that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard,
and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
verses.8:
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house,
the place where your glory dwells.
verses.9:
Don’t gather my soul with sinners,
nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
verses.10:
in whose hands is wickedness,
their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.11:
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity.
Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
verses.12:
My foot stands in an even place.
In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

verses.1:
Yahweh is my light and my salvation.
Whom shall I fear?
Yahweh is the strength of my life.
Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.2:
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh,
even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.3:
Though an army should encamp against me,
my heart shall not fear.
Though war should rise against me,
even then I will be confident.
verses.4:
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after:
that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life,
to see Yahweh’s beauty,
and to inquire in his temple.
verses.5:
For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion.
In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me.
He will lift me up on a rock.
verses.7:
Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice.
Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
verses.8:
When you said, “Seek my face,”
my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
verses.9:
Don’t hide your face from me.
Don’t put your servant away in anger.
You have been my help.
Don’t abandon me,
neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
verses.10:
When my father and my mother forsake me,
then Yahweh will take me up.
verses.11:
Teach me your way, Yahweh.
Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
verses.13:
I am still confident of this:
I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
verses.14:
Wait for Yahweh.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage.
Yes, wait for Yahweh.

verses.1:
To you, Yahweh, I call.
My rock, don’t be deaf to me;
lest, if you are silent to me,
I would become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.2:
Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you,
when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.3:
Don’t draw me away with the wicked,
with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors,
but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.4:
Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings.
Give them according to the operation of their hands.
Bring back on them what they deserve.
verses.5:
Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh,
nor the operation of his hands,
he will break them down and not build them up.
verses.6:
Blessed be Yahweh,
because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
verses.7:
Yahweh is my strength and my shield.
My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped.
Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.
With my song I will thank him.
verses.8:
Yahweh is their strength.
He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.9:
Save your people,
and bless your inheritance.
Be their shepherd also,
and bear them up forever.

verses.1:
Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty,
ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
verses.2:
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.
Worship Yahweh in holy array.
verses.3:
Yahweh’s voice is on the waters.
The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
verses.4:
Yahweh’s voice is powerful.
Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.5:
Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars.
Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.6:
He makes them also to skip like a calf;
Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
verses.7: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.8:
Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness.
Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.9:
Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve,
and strips the forests bare.
In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.10:
Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood.
Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
verses.11:
Yahweh will give strength to his people.
Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

verses.1:
Praise Yah!
Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh,
who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.2:
His offspring will be mighty in the land.
The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.3:
Wealth and riches are in his house.
His righteousness endures forever.
verses.4:
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright,
gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.5:
It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends.
He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.6:
For he will never be shaken.
The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.7:
He will not be afraid of evil news.
His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
verses.8:
His heart is established.
He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.9:
He has dispersed, he has given to the poor.
His righteousness endures forever.
His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.10:
The wicked will see it, and be grieved.
He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away.
The desire of the wicked will perish.

verses.1:
Praise Yah!
Praise, you servants of Yahweh,
praise Yahweh’s name.
verses.2:
Blessed be Yahweh’s name,
from this time forward and forever more.
verses.3:
From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same,
Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
verses.4:
Yahweh is high above all nations,
his glory above the heavens.
verses.5:
Who is like Yahweh, our God,
who has his seat on high,
verses.6: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
verses.7:
He raises up the poor out of the dust.
Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;
verses.8:
that he may set him with princes,
even with the princes of his people.
verses.9:
He settles the barren woman in her home,
as a joyful mother of children.
Praise Yah!

verses.1:
When Israel went out of Egypt,
the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;
verses.2:
Judah became his sanctuary,
Israel his dominion.
verses.3:
The sea saw it, and fled.
The Jordan was driven back.
verses.4:
The mountains skipped like rams,
the little hills like lambs.
verses.5:
What was it, you sea, that you fled?
You Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.6:
You mountains, that you skipped like rams;
you little hills, like lambs?
verses.7:
Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord,
at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.8:
who turned the rock into a pool of water,
the flint into a spring of waters.

verses.1:
Not to us, Yahweh, not to us,
but to your name give glory,
for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.2:
Why should the nations say,
“Where is their God, now?”
verses.3:
But our God is in the heavens.
He does whatever he pleases.
verses.4:
Their idols are silver and gold,
the work of men’s hands.
verses.5:
They have mouths, but they don’t speak.
They have eyes, but they don’t see.
verses.6:
They have ears, but they don’t hear.
They have noses, but they don’t smell.
verses.7:
They have hands, but they don’t feel.
They have feet, but they don’t walk,
neither do they speak through their throat.
verses.8:
Those who make them will be like them;
yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.9:
Israel, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.
verses.10:
House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.
verses.11:
You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh!
He is their help and their shield.
verses.12:
Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us.
He will bless the house of Israel.
He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.13:
He will bless those who fear Yahweh,
both small and great.
verses.14:
May Yahweh increase you more and more,
you and your children.
verses.15:
Blessed are you by Yahweh,
who made heaven and earth.
verses.16:
The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh;
but the earth has he given to the children of men.
verses.17:
The dead don’t praise Yah,
neither any who go down into silence;
verses.18:
But we will bless Yah,
from this time forward and forever more.
Praise Yah!

verses.1:
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice,
and my cries for mercy.
verses.2:
Because he has turned his ear to me,
therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.3:
The cords of death surrounded me,
the pains of Sheol got a hold of me.
I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.4:
Then I called on Yahweh’s name:
“Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.5:
Yahweh is Gracious and righteous.
Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.6:
Yahweh preserves the simple.
I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.7:
Return to your rest, my soul,
for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.8:
For you have delivered my soul from death,
my eyes from tears,
and my feet from falling.
verses.9: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
verses.10:
I believed, therefore I said,
“I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.11:
I said in my haste,
“All men are liars.”
verses.12: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
verses.13: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.14:
I will pay my vows to Yahweh,
yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.15: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
verses.16:
Yahweh, truly I am your servant.
I am your servant, the son of your servant.
You have freed me from my chains.
verses.17:
I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
and will call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.18:
I will pay my vows to Yahweh,
yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.19:
in the courts of Yahweh’s house,
in the middle of you, Jerusalem.
Praise Yah!

verses.1:
Praise Yahweh, all you nations!
Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.2:
For his loving kindness is great toward us.
Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever.
Praise Yah!

verses.1:
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.2:
Let Israel now say
that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.3:
Let the house of Aaron now say
that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.4:
Now let those who fear Yahweh say
that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.5:
Out of my distress, I called on Yah.
Yah answered me with freedom.
verses.6:
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?
verses.7:
Yahweh is on my side among those who help me.
Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.8:
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh,
than to put confidence in man.
verses.9:
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh,
than to put confidence in princes.
verses.10:
All the nations surrounded me,
but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
verses.11:
They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me.
In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.12:
They surrounded me like bees.
They are quenched like the burning thorns.
In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
verses.13:
You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
but Yahweh helped me.
verses.14:
Yah is my strength and song.
He has become my salvation.
verses.15:
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous.
“The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
verses.16:
The right hand of Yahweh is exalted!
The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
verses.17:
I will not die, but live,
and declare Yah’s works.
verses.18:
Yah has punished me severely,
but he has not given me over to death.
verses.19:
Open to me the gates of righteousness.
I will enter into them.
I will give thanks to Yah.
verses.20:
This is the gate of Yahweh;
the righteous will enter into it.
verses.21:
I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me,
and have become my salvation.
verses.22:
The stone which the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.
verses.23:
This is Yahweh’s doing.
It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.24:
This is the day that Yahweh has made.
We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.25:
Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh!
Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.26:
Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name!
We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
verses.27:
Yahweh is God, and he has given us light.
Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.28:
You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.
You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.29:
Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.1:
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless,
who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
verses.2:
Blessed are those who keep his statutes,
who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.3:
Yes, they do nothing wrong.
They walk in his ways.
verses.4:
You have commanded your precepts,
that we should fully obey them.
verses.5:
Oh that my ways were steadfast
to obey your statutes!
verses.6:
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed,
when I consider all of your commandments.
verses.7:
I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart,
when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.8:
I will observe your statutes.
Don’t utterly forsake me.
verses.9:
How can a young man keep his way pure?
By living according to your word.
verses.10:
With my whole heart, I have sought you.
Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.11:
I have hidden your word in my heart,
that I might not sin against you.
verses.12:
Blessed are you, Yahweh.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.13:
With my lips,
I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.14:
I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies,
as much as in all riches.
verses.15:
I will meditate on your precepts,
and consider your ways.
verses.16:
I will delight myself in your statutes.
I will not forget your word.
verses.17:
Do good to your servant.
I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.18:
Open my eyes,
that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.19:
I am a stranger on the earth.
Don’t hide your commandments from me.
verses.20: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.21:
You have rebuked the proud who are cursed,
who wander from your commandments.
verses.22:
Take reproach and contempt away from me,
for I have kept your statutes.
verses.23:
Though princes sit and slander me,
your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.24:
Indeed your statutes are my delight,
and my counselors.
verses.25:
My soul is laid low in the dust.
Revive me according to your word!
verses.26:
I declared my ways, and you answered me.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.27:
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts!
Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.28:
My soul is weary with sorrow:
strengthen me according to your word.
verses.29:
Keep me from the way of deceit.
Grant me your law graciously!
verses.30:
I have chosen the way of truth.
I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.31:
I cling to your statutes, Yahweh.
Don’t let me be disappointed.
verses.32:
I run in the path of your commandments,
for you have set my heart free.
verses.33:
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes.
I will keep them to the end.
verses.34:
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law.
Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.35:
Direct me in the path of your commandments,
for I delight in them.
verses.36:
Turn my heart toward your statutes,
not toward selfish gain.
verses.37:
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things.
Revive me in your ways.
verses.38:
Fulfill your promise to your servant,
that you may be feared.
verses.39:
Take away my disgrace that I dread,
for your ordinances are good.
verses.40:
Behold, I long for your precepts!
Revive me in your righteousness.
verses.41:
Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh,
your salvation, according to your word.
verses.42:
So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me,
for I trust in your word.
verses.43:
Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth,
for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.44:
So I will obey your law continually,
forever and ever.
verses.45:
I will walk in liberty,
for I have sought your precepts.
verses.46:
I will also speak of your statutes before kings,
and will not be disappointed.
verses.47:
I will delight myself in your commandments,
because I love them.
verses.48:
I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love.
I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.49:
Remember your word to your servant,
because you gave me hope.
verses.50:
This is my comfort in my affliction,
for your word has revived me.
verses.51:
The arrogant mock me excessively,
but I don’t swerve from your law.
verses.52:
I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh,
and have comforted myself.
verses.53:
Indignation has taken hold on me,
because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.54:
Your statutes have been my songs,
in the house where I live.
verses.55:
I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night,
and I obey your law.
verses.56:
This is my way,
that I keep your precepts.
verses.57:
Yahweh is my portion.
I promised to obey your words.
verses.58:
I sought your favor with my whole heart.
Be merciful to me according to your word.
verses.59:
I considered my ways,
and turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.60:
I will hurry, and not delay,
to obey your commandments.
verses.61:
The ropes of the wicked bind me,
but I won’t forget your law.
verses.62:
At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you,
because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.63:
I am a friend of all those who fear you,
of those who observe your precepts.
verses.64:
The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.65:
Do good to your servant,
according to your word, Yahweh.
verses.66:
Teach me good judgment and knowledge,
for I believe in your commandments.
verses.67:
Before I was afflicted, I went astray;
but now I observe your word.
verses.68:
You are good, and do good.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.69:
The proud have smeared a lie upon me.
With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
verses.70:
Their heart is as callous as the fat,
but I delight in your law.
verses.71:
It is good for me that I have been afflicted,
that I may learn your statutes.
verses.72: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
verses.73:
Your hands have made me and formed me.
Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.74:
Those who fear you will see me and be glad,
because I have put my hope in your word.
verses.75:
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous,
that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.76:
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort,
according to your word to your servant.
verses.77:
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live;
for your law is my delight.
verses.78:
Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully.
I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.79:
Let those who fear you turn to me.
They will know your statutes.
verses.80:
Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees,
that I may not be disappointed.
verses.81:
My soul faints for your salvation.
I hope in your word.
verses.82:
My eyes fail for your word.
I say, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.83:
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke.
I don’t forget your statutes.
verses.84:
How many are the days of your servant?
When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.85:
The proud have dug pits for me,
contrary to your law.
verses.86:
All of your commandments are faithful.
They persecute me wrongfully.
Help me!
verses.87:
They had almost wiped me from the earth,
but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
verses.88:
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness,
so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
verses.89: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
verses.90:
Your faithfulness is to all generations.
You have established the earth, and it remains.
verses.91:
Your laws remain to this day,
for all things serve you.
verses.92:
Unless your law had been my delight,
I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.93:
I will never forget your precepts,
for with them, you have revived me.
verses.94:
I am yours.
Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.95:
The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me.
I will consider your statutes.
verses.96:
I have seen a limit to all perfection,
but your commands are boundless.
verses.97:
How I love your law!
It is my meditation all day.
verses.98:
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
for your commandments are always with me.
verses.99:
I have more understanding than all my teachers,
for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.100:
I understand more than the aged,
because I have kept your precepts.
verses.101:
I have kept my feet from every evil way,
that I might observe your word.
verses.102:
I have not turned away from your ordinances,
for you have taught me.
verses.103:
How sweet are your promises to my taste,
more than honey to my mouth!
verses.104:
Through your precepts, I get understanding;
therefore I hate every false way.
verses.105:
Your word is a lamp to my feet,
and a light for my path.
verses.106:
I have sworn, and have confirmed it,
that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
verses.107:
I am afflicted very much.
Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
verses.108:
Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth.
Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
verses.109:
My soul is continually in my hand,
yet I won’t forget your law.
verses.110:
The wicked have laid a snare for me,
yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
verses.111:
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever,
for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.112:
I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever,
even to the end.
verses.113:
I hate double-minded men,
but I love your law.
verses.114:
You are my hiding place and my shield.
I hope in your word.
verses.115:
Depart from me, you evildoers,
that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.116:
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live.
Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.117:
Hold me up, and I will be safe,
and will have respect for your statutes continually.
verses.118:
You reject all those who stray from your statutes,
for their deceit is in vain.
verses.119:
You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross.
Therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.120:
My flesh trembles for fear of you.
I am afraid of your judgments.
verses.121:
I have done what is just and righteous.
Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
verses.122:
Ensure your servant’s well-being.
Don’t let the proud oppress me.
verses.123:
My eyes fail looking for your salvation,
for your righteous word.
verses.124:
Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.125:
I am your servant. Give me understanding,
that I may know your testimonies.
verses.126:
It is time to act, Yahweh,
for they break your law.
verses.127:
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold,
yes, more than pure gold.
verses.128:
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right.
I hate every false way.
verses.129:
Your testimonies are wonderful,
therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.130:
The entrance of your words gives light.
It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.131:
I opened my mouth wide and panted,
for I longed for your commandments.
verses.132:
Turn to me, and have mercy on me,
as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.133:
Establish my footsteps in your word.
Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.134:
Redeem me from the oppression of man,
so I will observe your precepts.
verses.135:
Make your face shine on your servant.
Teach me your statutes.
verses.136:
Streams of tears run down my eyes,
because they don’t observe your law.
verses.137:
You are righteous, Yahweh.
Your judgments are upright.
verses.138:
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness.
They are fully trustworthy.
verses.139:
My zeal wears me out,
because my enemies ignore your words.
verses.140:
Your promises have been thoroughly tested,
and your servant loves them.
verses.141:
I am small and despised.
I don’t forget your precepts.
verses.142:
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness.
Your law is truth.
verses.143:
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me.
Your commandments are my delight.
verses.144:
Your testimonies are righteous forever.
Give me understanding, that I may live.
verses.145:
I have called with my whole heart.
Answer me, Yahweh!
I will keep your statutes.
verses.146:
I have called to you. Save me!
I will obey your statutes.
verses.147:
I rise before dawn and cry for help.
I put my hope in your words.
verses.148:
My eyes stay open through the night watches,
that I might meditate on your word.
verses.149:
Hear my voice according to your loving kindness.
Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
verses.150:
They draw near who follow after wickedness.
They are far from your law.
verses.151:
You are near, Yahweh.
All your commandments are truth.
verses.152:
Of old I have known from your testimonies,
that you have founded them forever.
verses.153:
Consider my affliction, and deliver me,
for I don’t forget your law.
verses.154:
Plead my cause, and redeem me!
Revive me according to your promise.
verses.155:
Salvation is far from the wicked,
for they don’t seek your statutes.
verses.156:
Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh.
Revive me according to your ordinances.
verses.157:
Many are my persecutors and my adversaries.
I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
verses.158:
I look at the faithless with loathing,
because they don’t observe your word.
verses.159:
Consider how I love your precepts.
Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
verses.160:
All of your words are truth.
Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
verses.161:
Princes have persecuted me without a cause,
but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.162:
I rejoice at your word,
as one who finds great plunder.
verses.163:
I hate and abhor falsehood.
I love your law.
verses.164:
Seven times a day, I praise you,
because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.165:
Those who love your law have great peace.
Nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.166:
I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh.
I have done your commandments.
verses.167:
My soul has observed your testimonies.
I love them exceedingly.
verses.168:
I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies,
for all my ways are before you.
verses.169:
Let my cry come before you, Yahweh.
Give me understanding according to your word.
verses.170:
Let my supplication come before you.
Deliver me according to your word.
verses.171:
Let my lips utter praise,
for you teach me your statutes.
verses.172:
Let my tongue sing of your word,
for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.173:
Let your hand be ready to help me,
for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.174:
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh.
Your law is my delight.
verses.175:
Let my soul live, that I may praise you.
Let your ordinances help me.
verses.176:
I have gone astray like a lost sheep.
Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

verses.1:
In my distress, I cried to Yahweh.
He answered me.
verses.2:
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips,
from a deceitful tongue.
verses.3:
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you,
you deceitful tongue?
verses.4:
Sharp arrows of the mighty,
with coals of juniper.
verses.5:
Woe is me, that I live in Meshech,
that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.6:
My soul has had her dwelling too long
with him who hates peace.
verses.7:
I am for peace,
but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.1:
I will lift up my eyes to the hills.
Where does my help come from?
verses.2:
My help comes from Yahweh,
who made heaven and earth.
verses.3:
He will not allow your foot to be moved.
He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.4:
Behold, he who keeps Israel
will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.5:
Yahweh is your keeper.
Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
verses.6:
The sun will not harm you by day,
nor the moon by night.
verses.7:
Yahweh will keep you from all evil.
He will keep your soul.
verses.8:
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in,
from this time forward, and forever more.

verses.1:
I was glad when they said to me,
“Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
verses.2: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;
verses.3: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;
verses.4:
where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes,
according to an ordinance for Israel,
to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
verses.5:
For there are set thrones for judgment,
the thrones of David’s house.
verses.6:
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem.
Those who love you will prosper.
verses.7:
Peace be within your walls,
and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.8:
For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes,
I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.9:
For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God,
I will seek your good.

verses.1:
To you I do lift up my eyes,
you who sit in the heavens.
verses.2:
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress;
so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God,
until he has mercy on us.
verses.3:
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us,
for we have endured much contempt.
verses.4:
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,
with the contempt of the proud.

verses.1:
If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side,
let Israel now say,
verses.2:
if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side,
when men rose up against us;
verses.3:
then they would have swallowed us up alive,
when their wrath was kindled against us;
verses.4:
then the waters would have overwhelmed us,
the stream would have gone over our soul;
verses.5: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.6:
Blessed be Yahweh,
who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.7:
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare.
The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.8:
Our help is in Yahweh’s name,
who made heaven and earth.

verses.1:
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion,
which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
verses.2:
As the mountains surround Jerusalem,
so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
verses.3:
For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous;
so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
verses.4:
Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good,
to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.5:
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways,
Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity.
Peace be on Israel.

verses.1:
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion,
we were like those who dream.
verses.2:
Then our mouth was filled with laughter,
and our tongue with singing.
Then they said among the nations,
“Yahweh has done great things for them.”
verses.3:
Yahweh has done great things for us,
and we are glad.
verses.4:
Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh,
like the streams in the Negev.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.6:
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing,
will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

verses.1: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
verses.2: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
verses.3:
One called to another, and said,
“Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies!
The whole earth is full of his glory!”
verses.4: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.5: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
verses.6: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
verses.7: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
verses.8:
I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?”
Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
verses.9:
He said, “Go, and tell this people,
‘You hear indeed,
but don’t understand;
and you see indeed,
but don’t perceive.’
verses.10:
Make the heart of this people fat.
Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes;
lest they see with their eyes,
and hear with their ears,
and understand with their heart,
and turn again, and be healed.”
verses.11:
Then I said, “Lord, how long?”
He answered,
“Until cities are waste without inhabitant,
and houses without man,
and the land becomes utterly waste,
verses.12:
And Yahweh has removed men far away,
and the forsaken places are many within the land.
verses.13:
If there is a tenth left in it,
that also will in turn be consumed:
as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remains when they are felled;
so the holy seed is its stock.”

verses.1: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.2: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
verses.3: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.4: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.5: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
verses.6: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
verses.7: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
verses.8: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people;
verses.9: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
verses.10: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
verses.11: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
verses.12: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahweh.”
verses.13: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
verses.14: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.15: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.16: For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
verses.17: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.18: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.19: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
verses.20: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.21: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.22: and it shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
verses.23: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be for briers and thorns.
verses.24: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
verses.25: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.”

verses.1: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
verses.2: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
verses.3: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
verses.4: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
verses.5: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,
verses.6: “Because this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.7: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
verses.8: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through; it will reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, Immanuel.
verses.9: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
verses.10: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand: for God is with us.”
verses.11: For Yahweh spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.12: “Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.
verses.13: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
verses.14: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.15: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
verses.16: Wrap up the testimony. Seal the law among my disciples.
verses.17: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.18: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
verses.19: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter:” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.20: Turn to the law and to the testimony! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
verses.21: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry; and it will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse by their king and by their God. They will turn their faces upward,
verses.22: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

verses.1: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.2:
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.
verses.3:
You have multiplied the nation.
You have increased their joy.
They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
verses.4: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.5: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
verses.6: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.7: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.
verses.8:
The Lord sent a word into Jacob,
and it falls on Israel.
verses.9:
All the people will know,
including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
verses.10:
“The bricks have fallen,
but we will build with cut stone.
The sycamore fig trees have been cut down,
but we will put cedars in their place.”
verses.11:
Therefore Yahweh will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin,
and will stir up his enemies,
verses.12:
The Syrians in front,
and the Philistines behind;
and they will devour Israel with open mouth.
For all this, his anger is not turned away,
but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.13:
Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them,
neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.
verses.14:
Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail,
palm branch and reed, in one day.
verses.15:
The elder and the honorable man is the head,
and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
verses.16:
For those who lead this people lead them astray;
and those who are led by them are destroyed.
verses.18:
For wickedness burns like a fire.
It devours the briers and thorns;
yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest,
and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.21:
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah.
For all this his anger is not turned away,
but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.1: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;
verses.2: to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.3: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
verses.4:
They will only bow down under the prisoners,
and will fall under the slain.
For all this his anger is not turned away,
but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.5: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
verses.6: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me will I give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.7: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
verses.8: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
verses.9: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
verses.10: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.11: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.12: Therefore it will happen that, when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his haughty looks.
verses.13: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
verses.14: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
verses.15: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
verses.16: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
verses.17: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
verses.18: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
verses.19: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
verses.20: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.21: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
